title: Paris butter shop – level 2
paragraphs: A special butter shop in Paris is celebrating a beloved French food by offering around 30 different butter flavors.
Customers can choose savory options like wild garlic, herbs, onion, and seaweed, or sweet creations like chocolate, vanilla, and raspberry.

Butters from different regions also feature different amounts of fat, which changes their taste and texture. Once people taste this high-quality butter, they realize how different it is from ordinary supermarket butter.

High-quality butter melts smoothly on the tongue, feels wonderfully rich and creamy, and releases deep flavors. Experiencing this new world of taste is the main reason why so many people are currently fascinated by artisanal butter.

words.d: something new that has been made or created
made by hand in a traditional way and from high-quality ingredients
